2026-08-28.headline: The handheld's first seventy metres
2026-08-28.account: The record opens at 3:59 PM, fed by the handheld GPS and read off the device over USB rather than from anyone's phone. Across the next two hours Hermes covered seventy metres in total, about the width of its own parking spot, and the log closes at 5:57 PM. The one stop long enough to earn a name is 8:45 & F, thirty-one minutes from the first fix and some fifty metres off the corner itself. All forty-eight fixes sat more than 1.1 km from the Man, out to 1,388 metres at the farthest, which says less about roaming than about where the camp was pitched. No art was logged nearby, no phone was feeding, and nothing was asked of the car.

2026-08-29.headline: Five recorders, one corner
2026-08-29.account: A pre-dawn start at 3:38 AM and a last fix at 3:02 PM, with two kilometres between them across two journeys. Five different source labels fed the log today — the handheld's track, its position exports, and two from the collar — which says more about what was being tested than about where Hermes went. The named stop is again 8:45 & F, forty-two minutes from the first fix. Forty-one per cent of the day's fixes counted as deep playa, reaching 1,384 metres from the Man, and the rest fell nearer in. Nearly twelve hours separate the first fix from the last, and the log has nothing at all to say about most of them.

2026-08-30.headline: First night on phone positions
2026-08-30.account: The phones took over: this is the first day the log is fed by a handset rather than the handheld, and Joel's is the one named. Eighteen fixes is not much for six hours, and the 7.7 kilometres between them is a figure to hold loosely — with gaps that wide the distance is the straight line between what was recorded, not the route that was driven. The evening runs from 5:46 PM to 11:48 PM, and a nine-minute stop at 8:45 & F at 10:35 PM is the only pause long enough to name. Eighty-nine per cent of the fixes were deep playa, the farthest reaching 1,495 metres from the Man.

2026-08-31.headline: Twenty-six kilometres, and the DMZ
2026-08-31.account: The longest day in the log by distance: twenty-six kilometres across four journeys, from a fix at 12:10 AM to the last at 10:00 PM, all of it from Joel's phone. The single stop that earns a name is out at the Deep-Playa Music Zone, twenty-three minutes from 1:02 AM, and the geocoder places it roughly three hundred metres off the official marker rather than at it. Only thirty-one per cent of the day's fixes were deep playa despite the farthest reaching 1,616 metres, so most of the running was inside the city. A hundred and nine fixes across twenty-two hours leaves long silences, and the distance is measured straight across them.

2026-09-01.headline: A second phone, and the request box opens
2026-09-01.account: Coral Daddy's phone joined Joel's, so two handsets were feeding positions for the first time. Six journeys and 11.9 kilometres between 2:01 AM and 10:51 PM, with two stops worth naming: the Deep-Playa Music Zone at 2:09 AM for seventeen minutes, and 8:45 & F for twelve minutes at 8:55 PM. Sixty-four per cent of the day was deep playa, out to 1,618 metres. The request log has its first entry today, but it is a seed row written to test the box rather than anyone actually asking for a ride — a pickup at Center Camp, filed by the system against its own name. Nobody real had found the form yet.

2026-09-02.headline: The night the requests started arriving
2026-09-02.account: The day the whole thing worked. Six hundred and seventy-seven fixes, more than any other day in the log, and Joel's phone carried nearly all of them: four hundred and forty-eight accepted, a hundred and eighteen turned away by the accuracy gate. Art proximity logging begins here too — Hermes came within six metres of Small Beginnings around 8:55 PM, and passed I Have Dust In Curious Places and the art car The Future Mirror within the same few minutes. Five requests came in, and unlike yesterday's seed they were from people: pickups at 2 and E and at 12 and D, and three DJ sets — Unitone Florian Thor asking for 2 to 4 AM out of Bisou with a ride on deep playa, Justin Rezvani for a sunrise set, Anton Piskunov for house, bright major tones.

2026-09-03.headline: All night out past the fence
2026-09-03.account: A night spent entirely outside the city: every one of the hundred and seventy-one fixes counted as deep playa, and the farthest reached 1,996 metres from the Man, the deepest the log ever puts Hermes. The nine journeys only add up to 1.9 kilometres, because the car kept coming back — 8:45 & F accounts for an hour and thirty-six minutes across four separate visits. The hours worth having are between three and six in the morning, out with Altar of Awen at fifty metres, A Quiet Place to Scream at eighty-five and Polio Rodeo at a hundred and fifty, and the art cars Puzzling Evidence and Trash Fence Souvenirs logged alongside. Both phones were feeding: Joel's five hundred and eighty-seven fixes, Coral Daddy's three hundred and one. Nobody filed a request all day.

2026-09-04.headline: Minerva asks four times
2026-09-04.account: A short, dense evening: a hundred and fifty-one fixes between 6:09 PM and 10:22 PM, 3.1 kilometres, all of it deep playa. Hermes stood near the Deep-Playa Music Zone for thirty-two minutes across two visits from 7:08 PM, and spent the two hours from then within sixty metres of The Lightning Tower, with G String forty-one minutes at seventy metres later on, and Island of Lost Buoys, Hex-Pand and the art cars Saṃsāra and Trash Fence Souvenirs all in reach. Every request today came from the same person. Minerva filed four: three pickups at 8:45 & G, by the helicopter art car at BRC Metro Chop, and one DJ set for herself and Digital — roaming around, party hopping, anytime you want to pick us up.

2026-09-05.headline: One minute of record, close in
2026-09-05.account: Almost nothing. Five fixes, all at 8:17 PM, thirty metres apart. Whatever Hermes did on Saturday it did without the tracker running, and the one minute that was recorded puts it close in — two hundred and nine metres from the Man at the farthest, the only day in the log with no deep playa in it at all. In that minute it was sixteen metres from As Above So Below, with the art cars Nora and The Future Mirror a couple of hundred metres off. Joel's phone logged sixteen accepted positions and five rejected. The absence is the fact worth keeping: Saturday is missing from the record, not from the week.

2026-09-06.headline: Three hours after midnight
2026-09-06.account: Eleven fixes across the three hours after midnight, from 1:12 AM to 4:22 AM, covering 1.8 kilometres. The record is thin enough that it reads as three glimpses rather than a night: Plastic Planet at thirty-seven metres just after one, Enceladus about three hundred metres off at 3:56 AM, and OVO Ignis at the last fix at 4:22 AM, by which point Hermes was 1,759 metres out. The art cars What Lies Beneath?, The Future Mirror and Trash Fence Souvenirs were logged further off. Joel's phone accepted ninety-eight positions and rejected eleven, so rather more arrived than the track log kept.

2026-09-07.headline: The last fix
2026-09-07.account: The log ends here, with eight fixes at 9:36 PM and thirty metres between them. Hermes was seven hundred and fifty-two metres from the Man, inside the city, with Message to the Parents We Should Have Had a few hundred metres away and the art car Panopticonotopia 3.0! beyond it. Joel's phone put in twenty-six accepted positions and seven rejected, and then the record stops. Nothing after this was written down.
